scope: Prespecified single-case development diagnostic, conditional known-noise cubic pose audit; not experimental calibration or pose-optimized weights
pose_set: Per-particle joint ball: squared scaled rotation norm plus squared scaled translation norm <= 1
numerical_scope: Ordinary floating-point guards and independent numerical checks, not interval arithmetic

source_snapshot.interpretation: Exact archived source bytes are authoritative; HEAD may precede uncommitted development edits.

scaling_method: Positive sampled block norms used only to choose scales; not integration certificates

spectral_upper_certificate.scope: Probability over fresh design-only Gaussian probes for a fixed PSD matrix, in real arithmetic; not validated floating point.

pilot_numerical_check.scope: Selected frequencies: independent physical-cell sums and 24-node within-cell quadrature; not global numerical certification

reference_checks_origin: Exact nonlinear source means reused at identical weights, geometry, noise and target; no new reference projections or outcomes selected
